name: Configurable approval workflow engine and task decisions
description: User views pending approval tasks, filters by priority and status, and inspects approval workflow definitions.

planSteps.description: Navigate to Approvals in the top navigation bar or menu
Verify Pending Approvals workbench renders overdue badge counts and action buttons for approve and reject
Navigate to Workflow Definitions page under Admin settings
Verify workflow definition rules, multi-step approval levels, and role permissions are displayed
